ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and send the driver's account to Ryde for review of the false "I'm Here" arrival confirmation.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a driver-cancelled no-show dispute, so it enters the policy through NS-0: cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims the rider no-showed, which routes the case to NS-1/NS-2 [F3][F12][NS-0]. The trace settles the NS-1 elements by code: the trace covers the wait without a hole, and the arrival confirmation was a driver tap at 22:37:20 [F5][NS-1].

NS-1 (ii) fails. At the moment of the "I'm Here" tap the driver was 1000 m from the pickup point, and his closest approach during the whole episode was 873 m — he never came within the 200 m pickup radius [F1][F5][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails: after the tap he stayed inside the pickup radius for 0 s, so there was no continuous wait of more than 3 minutes at the pickup, whatever the driver wrote after the fact [F5][F12][NS-1].

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are not all satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is fully refunded to the rider, refund_full [F6][F3][NS-2]. The amount is the cancellation fee recorded in the fare and timeline records: $6.61 [F6][F3][NS-2].

NS-2 additionally requires an account flag where the driver confirmed arrival while GPS showed he was not at the pickup point: the tap at 22:37:20 was 1000 m away, a false arrival confirmation, so flag_account is set [F5][F1][NS-2]. The driver's later statement that he "waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" is a post-hoc assertion that the GPS and timeline records contradict; system records override statements, so it cannot rescue the fee [F12][F3][F5][NS-1][NS-2]. The rider's profile (1 dispute in 90 d, 0 upheld) and the driver's profile (2 no-show disputes upheld in 90 d) do not decide anything; profile facts never decide a case alone [F16][F17][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read all three chat messages (driver's "Reached already, blue Toyota Prius, come out please"; rider's "I'm at the pickup point, no car here. Where are you?"; driver's "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel"), the complaint and the driver's statement. They are a dispute about location and a cancellation, with no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so safety_concern = none [F8][F9][F10][F12]. Traffic and weather records are irrelevant here and show nothing that excuses the driver's failure to approach the pickup [F13][F14][F15][RD-4].

Both briefs requested no_action. That outcome is incompatible with NS-2: once NS-1 (ii) and (iii) fail, the cancellation fee cannot stand and the fee must be fully refunded [F5][F1][F6][NS-1][NS-2].

The driver advocate's requested outcome no_action, and the driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup, are contradicted by the GPS/timeline records: 1000 m away at the tap and 0 s within 200 m afterwards; system records override statements, so NS-1 (ii)(iii) fail and NS-2 refunds the fee [F12][F5][F1][F6][NS-1][NS-2].
